### [AlphaAgent: LLM-Driven Alpha Mining with Regularized Exploration to Counteract Alpha Decay](<https://doi.org/10.1145/3711896.3736838>)

**Catalog ID:** 2025-kdd-tang-alphaagent

**Authors:** Ziyi Tang, Zechuan Chen, Jiarui Yang, Jiayao Mai, Yongsen Zheng, Keze Wang, Jinrui Chen, Liang Lin

**Venue / year:** KDD · 2025

**Track / presentation:** Main · Not Specified

**Subvenue:** Research Track

**Status / verified:** Published · 2026-08-12

**Topics:** Alpha Modeling · Factor Investing · Financial Agents

**Assets / frequency:** Equities · Daily

**Tasks:** alpha mining · factor generation · backtesting

**Methods:** large language models · multi-agent systems · regularized exploration

**Datasets:** CSI 500 · S&amp;P 500

**Identifiers:** arXiv 2502.16789 · DOI 10.1145/3711896.3736838

**Focus:** Builds an autonomous LLM-agent framework for generating, testing, and regularizing alpha factors to reduce crowding and decay.

**Why it matters:** Converts market hypotheses into candidate factor signals while explicitly penalizing repetitive, decay-prone alpha discovery.
